message.content:
將兩個十六進制顏色 **#FAEBD7**（Antique White）與 **#00FFFF**（Cyan）平均混合（等量混合）：

| 色彩通道 | #FAEBD7 | #00FFFF | 平均值 |
|----------|--------|--------|--------|
| R (紅)   | 250    | 0      | 125 → 0x7D |
| G (綠)   | 235    | 255    | 245 → 0xF5 |
| B (藍)   | 215    | 255    | 235 → 0xEB |

平均後得到的 RGB 值為 **(125, 245, 235)**，對應的十六進制顏色碼為 **#7DF5EB**。

> **新顏色：#7DF5EB**  
> 這是一種淡藍綠色，介於 Antique White 的柔和米色與 Cyan 的鮮亮藍綠之間。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "混合顏色#FAEBD7和#00FFFF，新的顏色是什麼？" They want to mix two colors: #FAEBD7 (AntiqueWhite) and #00FFFF (Cyan). They want the resulting color. We need to compute the average of the RGB components. #FAEBD7: hex FA=250, EB=235, D7=215. #00FFFF: 00=0, FF=255, FF=255. Average: (250+0)/2=125, (235+255)/2=245, (215+255)/2=235. So new color: #7D F5 EB? Wait 125 decimal is 7D hex, 245 decimal is F5 hex, 235 decimal is EB hex. So #7DF5EB. That is the average. But maybe they want to mix by blending equally. So answer: #7DF5EB.
